nt2e41.title: First scarf day
nt2e41.caption:
Leo walked out in slow motion for the first scarf of winter. The scarf had other plans, and so did Libra.
Who in your life would happily share a scarf?

nt2e42.title: The window seat
nt2e42.caption:
Rain on the glass, deep thoughts, a whole movie in Cancer's head. Then the bus kept going.
Ever missed your stop and found something better?

nt2e43.title: The dropped book
nt2e43.caption:
Gemini dropped the book for the big meet-cute. Virgo reached for it with their own title card ready.
Two main characters, one café. Who gets top billing?

nt2e44.title: Catching the train
nt2e44.caption:
Sagittarius sprinted for the last train like the credits were rolling. The doors had opinions. Aquarius did not let them win.
Who holds the door for you?

nt2e45.title: Tears in the snow
nt2e45.caption:
Pisces wanted one perfect tear in the first snow. It froze and went clink. Scorpio showed up with a tissue and cocoa anyway.
Tag the friend who brings the cocoa.

nt2e46.title: A first date, explained badly
nt2e46.caption:
Virgo's whiteboard breakdown of a first date: two strangers, one table, snacks, and two people insisting they're chill.
What would you add to the diagram?

nt2e47.title: A crush, explained badly
nt2e47.caption:
Capricorn explains a crush with a marker and zero chill: a tab opens in your brain and it simply never closes.
How long have you re-read one text?

nt2e48.title: Cuffing season, explained badly
nt2e48.caption:
Aquarius explains cuffing season with penguins, which honestly tracks. The blanket is optional. The person is the point.
Team blanket or team person?

nt2e49.title: Meeting the parents, explained badly
nt2e49.caption:
Gemini says meeting the parents is a job interview with lasagna and your baby photos on a slideshow. Then the twist: they're nervous too.
What did you bring the first time?
